errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.COMPONENT_CYCLE: A component cannot contain itself, also not through another component.
errors.UNKNOWN_INGREDIENT: One of the ingredients no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_EQUIPMENT: One of the equipment items no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_COMPONENT: One of the components no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.DISH_NOT_FOUND: This dish no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.MENU_EMPTY: Put at least one dish on the menu before publishing.
errors.TABLE_LABEL_TAKEN: Another table already has this number.
errors.TABLE_IN_USE: Guests are seated at this table. Try again after the visit is closed.
errors.FLOOR_NOT_FOUND: This floor no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.STAFF_SELF: You cannot change your own roles.
errors.STAFF_ORG_ROLE: This person has a role at every location. An owner changes that.

recipes.intro: Changes here stay in the draft. Service keeps working from the published menu until you publish again under Menus.

ingredients.usedIn: {count, plural, one {Used in # component} other {Used in # components}}
ingredients.synonymsHint: Separated by commas. Waiters find the ingredient by these too.
ingredients.verified: Verified against the label or spec sheet
ingredients.verifiedHint: Unverified ingredients make every dish with them “unknown” for allergy guests.
ingredients.verifyNotAllowed: Only a chef, manager or owner can verify ingredients.
ingredients.reverify: The allergens changed. Saving with this checked records a new check, by you, now.

components.omittableHint: The kitchen can serve the dish without it.
components.premixedHint: Already in its parent or the dish, so it cannot be left off or swapped.
components.suitableForSevereHint: Lets it replace another component for a severe allergy.

menu.intro: Choose the dishes and their order, then publish. Waiters and the kitchen only see the published version.
menu.neverPublished: Nothing published yet: service uses the recipes as they are.
menu.changed: The draft or a recipe on it differs from what is live.
menu.upToDate: The live menu matches the draft.
menu.publishNote: {count, plural, one {# dish goes live for service at once. Orders already placed keep the recipe they were ordered from.} other {# dishes go live for service at once. Orders already placed keep the recipe they were ordered from.}}
menu.publishNotAllowed: Only a manager or owner can publish.
menu.warnings: {count, plural, one {# thing to check before publishing} other {# things to check before publishing}}

warning.UNVERIFIED_INGREDIENT: {dish}: {name} is not verified, so the dish shows as unknown for allergy guests.

floors.intro: Floors appear in this order in the service app. A hidden floor, like a closed terrace, disappears from service and keeps its tables.
floors.name: Floor name
floors.hiddenHint: Waiters do not see this floor now.
floors.inUse: Guests are seated here: the label stays, and seats cannot drop below the highest seat in use.
floors.label: Table number
floors.externalRefHint: Only when it differs from the table number.
floors.passCheck: Check allergy plates at the pass
floors.passCheckHint: A runner checks each allergy plate again before it goes to the table.

staff.intro: Everyone who signs in on this location's devices, with their roles here and their PIN.
staff.self: This is you. Someone else changes your roles.

roleHints.MANAGER: Floor plan, staff, publishing the menu, overrides.
roleHints.CHEF: Recipes and ingredients, verifying them, the kitchen.
roleHints.COOK: The kitchen display and plate checks.
roleHints.RUNNER: Checking and serving plates at the pass.

staff.orgRoles: Also {roles} at every location. An owner changes that.
staff.pinHint: 4 to 6 digits. Can also be set later.
staff.hasPin: Has a PIN for this location.
staff.noPin: No PIN yet: cannot sign in here.
staff.lockedHint: Locked after five wrong tries. Set a new PIN to unlock.
staff.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from this location? Their roles here and their PIN go.
